doc.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

title: Satchmo's note on Iola's lyrics; unhooking the microphone
summary: Brubeck recalls Armstrong writing 'Mrs. Brubeck, I am very happy' on Iola's lyrics before the recording is wrapped up.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: You know when Iola wrote that, those words, and gave them to Louis Armstrong, he wrote across the manuscript, “Mrs. Brubeck, I am very happy, Satchmo.” I think I’ve got that here.
One second, Dave, we’ve got to unhook you.
Oh, I almost ran with it.
Well why don’t we just — I’ll just say good-bye here. All right? Is that okay?
Do I have to hook up?

I don’t know. Just hook him up there, Tim, and I’ll just wrap this up. Yeah that’s a beautiful, I’ll send you, I’ll burn it on a little CD for you and send it because it’s just totally gorgeous. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
